ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In figure, in $ \triangle ABC$, $AB=AC$, $AD$ is the median to side $BC$, $DE\perp AB$ at point $E$. Triangles $ \triangle BDE \sim \triangle CAD$. If $AC=13$, $BC=10$, find the length of the line segment $BE$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $AD$ is the median line on side $BC$ and $BC=10$,\\
since $BD=CD=\frac{1}{2}BC=5$,\\
since $\triangle BDE\sim \triangle CAD$ and $AC=13$,\\
therefore $\frac{BE}{CD}=\frac{BD}{AC}$,\\
which means $\frac{BE}{5}=\frac{5}{13}$,\\
therefore $BE=\boxed{\frac{25}{13}}$.
